subject: Org people update: engagement survey follow-ups & at-risk list
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@peopleops.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Org people update: engagement survey follow-ups & at-risk list

Team —

Quick summary and asks after the Q4 engagement results and recent 1:1s. Attached is the anonymized engagement-summary and a blank manager action template. High-level: some pockets of strong engagement, plus a small set of mid‑senior ICs flagged for attrition risk (mostly around role clarity and career path). I want a conservative, low-noise approach — managers should own follow-ups and we coordinate closely with PeopleOps.

Action items (please do these by next Tuesday 3/2):
- Each manager listed in the tracker (link below) to confirm outreach plan and one concrete next step for each at-risk person.
- Share any names that need immediate HR escalations (confidential) directly to Elena.
- If you're planning to open a backfill or role change, flag to hiring (we'll loop HiringPartner) so we can parallelize recruitment.

I deliberately kept the summary anonymized — do not forward the PDF outside this thread. If you need the redacted-to-names mapping, send to Elena and me off-thread.

Links: https://drive.google.com/engagement-q4-2025-summary (anonymized), https://notion.redwood.com/people/at-risk-tracker
Attachments referenced: engagement-survey-summary-q4-2025.pdf, manager_action_template.docx

Priority: medium-high. Thanks — Mark

--
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@peopleops.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Org people update: engagement survey follow-ups & at-risk list

Thanks Mark — reading through now. Quick updates from my org (SRE & infra):

- I scheduled manager check-ins for next week (Mon/Tue).
- Two mid-level ICs have been flagged by their managers for career progression conversations; managers will (1) outline a 6‑month growth plan, (2) set up a calibration with me by 3/5.
- One engineer is actively interviewing elsewhere — manager asked for an off-cycle stay conversation this week. I'll handle the outreach and will update the tracker.

On escalation: I agree with the low-noise approach. For the active interview, I'll send Elena the details off-thread.

On recruiting: if we need a backfill, I'll open a req and loop HiringPartner.

On the template — small ask: can we add a "confidence" checkbox (manager has high/medium/low confidence plan will retain this person)? That will help prioritize follow-ups.

Monica

Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Org people update: engagement survey follow-ups & at-risk list

Appreciate the note, Markus. A couple of leader-level items: 

- Please do not include individual names in follow-up threads unless absolutely necessary. For escalations that require formal HR involvement (performance concerns, potential policy issues), include PeopleOps directly and mark the email as confidential.
- We should agree on two optional escalation outcomes managers can recommend: (1) retention plan + career path work, (2) role change/backfill + redeployment. Makes approvals faster.
- On sensitivity: senior IC flagged in the tracker may be public-facing nationally (we should treat that with extra discretion). I'll work with Elena on tooling access control for the tracker.

I'll take point on aligning the two outcomes with Finance for potential compensation moves — will update by 3/4.

Laura

Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Org people update: engagement survey follow-ups & at-risk list

Thanks for including PeopleOps. Quick plan and what I need from managers: 

1) Confidential escalations: send names + brief reason + desired outcome to me directly (elena@peopleops.com). PeopleOps will log on the confidential case tracker (private) and advise on formal next steps.

2) Manager Action Template: updated version attached (I added the "confidence" field and a prioritization column). Please use this so we have consistent data across teams.

3) Timing: aim to have all manager updates in the tracker by 03/02 COB. PeopleOps will triage any "high risk" items (confidence = low or active external interview) by 03/05 and suggest immediate retention/comp options.

4) Hiring coordination: if a backfill is requested, cc recruit@hiringpartner.com and copy me so we can start an expedited loop.

Attachments: manager_action_template.docx (v2)

Happy to join a 30-min sync next week if you think that'll help.

— Elena
People Operations Consultant

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@peopleops.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Org people update: engagement survey follow-ups & at-risk list

Thanks everyone — clear plan. Two quick next steps from me:

- Monica: please send the one active-interview case to Elena now (off-thread) and update the tracker. If we need a rapid stay conversation, I'll join.
- Laura: coordinate the escalation outcomes with Finance and share the proposed approval matrix by 3/4.
- Vivek: can you confirm whether any PM-facing roles in your org should be prioritized for hiring in parallel? If yes, open a req and cc HiringPartner.

I'll schedule a short 20-minute leadership check-in for Friday 3/5 at 9am PT to review the high-risk slate. Calendar invite forthcoming.

Please keep all names confined to direct HR channels. Thanks — Mark

--
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
